result:
I added an "Update Validation Status (Bulk)" operation (`setValidationBulk`) to the Submission resource of the KoBoToolbox node. I did not run tests, lint or the app, as you asked. I also did not re-run the `as`-cast check after my last edit, so I do not know whether it passes.

- **Inputs:** `SubmissionDescription.ts` has a new "Submission IDs" field for the comma-separated list. The operation reuses the Form ID and Validation Status fields.
- **Validation:** `parseSubmissionIds` in `GenericFunctions.ts` trims each ID. It throws a `NodeOperationError` for an empty list or any ID that is not all digits. It runs before any request is sent.
- **Execution:** `KoBoToolbox.node.ts` sends one `PATCH` to `/validation_status/` for each ID and returns one item per submission. Each item is `{ submissionId, updated: true }` or `{ submissionId, updated: false, error }`.
- **Why one request per ID:** I used one request per ID instead of KoBoToolbox's bulk endpoint. That endpoint returns only a summary, so it cannot report which submissions failed. One failed ID does not stop the rest.
- **Lint rule:** the `local/no-as-cast` hook flagged two `as` casts in the first version. I replaced them with `String(...)` and an `unknown` parameter type.
- **Not done:** I did not add unit tests for the new parser or operation.
